description: Edit only the requested properties of an existing drawing; all others are preserved. For a text edit send just {id,text,fontSize}; never copy the entire stored style or its hex colours. Get the id from chart_state. Use it to keep several drawings apart — a measured level and a projected one should not be the same colour, and a reader has only the picture to tell them by. Changes the chart you are building; finish with chart_link, or analysis_prepare for a sharing draft that needs human review.

color.description: A palette name. “up” and “down” are the reserved green and red — they assert a bullish or bearish claim, so use them for position zones and not for a measurement.

fontSize.description: Size 9–160px, normally 12–16 for readable text. Emoji render at twice this size.

opacity.description: Strength of the whole drawing, 0.1 to 1. Fade a level that is context rather than the decision.

text.description:
Required for text/note/callout: concise words, with 
 for short lines. For emoji: one Unicode emoji, e.g. 👀 or ⚠️. Max 500 characters.

wrapText.description: Default true: wrap long annotation lines for readability. False only for an explicitly requested single-line label.

name: drawing_style
